page.layout: One column of running text, set in roman and italic, with the page number at the head. No running head, marginal notes or footnotes. Left margin shows only show-through and stains, which are left out. At the foot, right of the last line, the word "Sic" stands alone as a catchword.

main_text.p: tiquorumque instituto illis contradita fuisse, & communi omnium calculo diffemi-nata, quæ, licet ringatur Hottingerus, ritibus, ac cerimonijs, nec non dogmatibus Pontificiorum, & Græcorum non absimilia sunt, & hæreticorum recentiorum dictatis maiori ex parte contraria. Quare detonet Hottingerus quidquid de illis vult, ac in mentem venerit, non id efficiet, vt perpetua Orientalium, & Pontificiorum veritas infirmetur: eo enim magis foras pellucebit, quo magis ab infidis occultatur.

Obseruamus Orientales, vel Reformatis per omnia accedere, vel in circumstantijs tantum-variare, vel vbi Pontificijs videntur fauere-partibus, illud ex principijs fluere Pontificiorum, etiam opinione erroneis. &c. Atque sic non negamus Orientales Ecclesias cum Romana aliquid habere fimile, plura tamen nobiscum-. Quis similia audiit? Si saniori mente rem considerasset, Hottingerus, respirasset paululum illius pertinacia, atque temeritas, aliquid loci, & consilio datum fuisset, nec in tantam turpitudinem venisset, vt hoc sibi esset apud integros iudicio viros confitendum. Non erit itaque abs re, si Græcorum præcipua producta, neque enim omnia tempus concedit, conferamus, vt infra.

page.notes: Printed "tantum-" and "fauere-" and "nobiscum-" end lines with a dash after the word; kept as printed. "audiit" is printed "audijt" (vowel i in j form), corrected to i. "ringatur" and "detonet" read as printed but are doubtful in sense. Long s is printed as s throughout. Bottom-left margin shows show-through only.
